headline: Government moves to tight austerity: what will happen to pensions and salaries
summary: The Cabinet of Ministers is introducing strict austerity in budget spending because of rapidly growing army needs. It also plans a detailed audit of Defence Ministry expenditures.
why: Budget austerity and defence spending shape Ukraine's fiscal position, financing needs and its reliance on external support, which matter for investors in Ukrainian sovereign debt and reconstruction.
